prompt: A unit test passes locally but fails intermittently on CI. Help me handle it.
setup: The test relies on the current wall-clock time and a fixed sleep for async work.
expected: The root cause is diagnosed before any test is muted.
The fix controls time and waits on a condition instead of sleeping.
Any temporary quarantine is tracked with an owner and a re-enable plan.
must_not: Recommend blind retries until the test passes.
Loosen the assertion until the behavior is no longer verified.
Mask a real product bug behind a skip.
